# scheduler commands

Every `scheduler` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `scheduler:list`

List all enabled schedule definitions and their next due time

```bash
bin/semitexa scheduler:list
```

## `scheduler:plan`

Materialize due recurring schedule occurrences into run rows

```bash
bin/semitexa scheduler:plan
```

## `scheduler:run-now`

Create an immediate run for a schedule key (operator intervention)

```bash
bin/semitexa scheduler:run-now "<schedule-key>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--inline` | no |

## `scheduler:work`

Run the scheduler worker for a given pool

```bash
bin/semitexa scheduler:work ["pool"]
```
